files.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make a production sprite sheet of nine animation key poses for a single existing adult fantasy action RPG hero. Use the input as a strict design reference for the LEFT COLUMN copper-haired adult male swordsman with navy-and-silver armor with gold trim, red scarf and cape, and silver sword. Draw ONLY that swordsman in every new cell. Match face, costume, anatomy, age, colors, equipment, dark pixel outlines, saturated selective highlights and refined hand-pixelled 16-bit JRPG style exactly. All poses full body, seen from the same 3/4 view facing RIGHT, close in scale and population of native pixel clusters; draw with crisp opaque sprite interiors, small faces at game scale, distinct silhouettes. Compose a SQUARE THREE COLUMNS × THREE ROWS atlas, precisely aligned. Each sprite centered at x=1/6, 1/2, 5/6 and y≈1/6, 1/2, 5/6, with consistent feet baseline within its own row; keep every extremity within its cell, leave at least 14% of each tile clear all the way around the sprite and double spacing between cells. No perspective variation, no environmental scenery, floor shadows, motion trails, magic glow, arrows in the air, labels, lines, guides, numbering, text, or drawn boxes. Truly alpha-transparent background. Row 1 from left to right is a single normal attack sequence: draws the sword back beside his shoulder; completes a short forward cut with his sword lowered and cape sweeping; pulls the sword and shoulder back into his guard. Row 2 from left to right is a compact backwards evasive step (facing right in all three poses): bends both knees and lowers their center of gravity while holding their weapon in close; kicks away to the left with the right foot, clothes or hair trailing right, weapon tucked close; lands in a low balanced defensive stance with front foot extended right. Row 3 from left to right is a brief reaction to a hit from the right: sharp recoil from the waist, shoulders and weapon twitch backwards, expression alert; bends their knees and hunches slightly, weapon held low and off balance; regains an upright guard and resets the weapon. Make each of the nine poses a clearly distinct animation silhouette, keeping the character recognizable and the feet/hip pivot reasonably consistent within each row. Preserve gameplay-readable balance and regular grid. Output exactly nine sprites of this one character and no other characters.
